{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Dark straight-leg jeans, full length with a slight stretch, in indigo (#2F3A52), mid-weight stretch denim
Fine-knit crew-neck sweater, relaxed fit, hip length, in sage green (#8FA597), merino-cotton blend
Long-sleeve cotton tee, fitted, slim cut, as a base layer under the sweater, in cream (#F2E8D0), soft jersey
Short trench-style jacket, straight cut, hitting at the hip, in warm sand (#C9B08A), water-resistant cotton twill
Leather ankle boots, low stacked block heel (about 3 cm), cushioned insole, rounded toe, in cognac (#9A5B34), smooth leather with a rubber sole
Wool-blend scarf, long and lightweight, in soft mustard (#D4A94F), woven wool and viscose
Crossbody bag, compact with a zip closure, in tan (#B88555), pebbled leather
Thin cotton socks, ankle length, in cream (#F2E8D0), with cushioned soles

This outfit is built for nine hours of walking on cobblestones in cool autumn air, so every piece prioritizes comfort and easy layering. The tee, sweater and light jacket let her adjust to +12 °C as the day warms and cools, and the scarf adds warmth at the neck without bulk. The sage green, sand and mustard sit in a warm, earthy range that flatters her golden-blonde hair, warm skin and grey-green eyes. The cushioned, low-heeled boots grip uneven stones, and the hands-free crossbody keeps her free to take photos and explore."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":2492,"output_tokens":550},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
